findings.summary: The frozen I0, I1, W0, D0, and patch-level P0 controls all executed. Ambient, pinned, and governed webgpu@0.3.0 fail; Doe completes all 13 assertions and the 110-function compilation corpus; webgpu@0.3.10 is not reliable under repeated clean processes and replay.

The webgpu@0.3.10 P0 control passes a one-process smoke but fails all three frozen clean processes in Node test-worker deserialization; the receipt replay later passes, proving the control is nondeterministic rather than a sufficient correction.
D0 is the only governed lane that passes every clean process, exposes physical AMD Vulkan identity, reports zero native compiler diagnostics, and reproduces its exact execution evidence hash.

limitations: The unchanged upstream workload validates shader-module compilation and diagnostics but does not dispatch the generated functions or validate semantic output.
The P0 module was supplied from another prepared workspace; its module hash and version are bound, but this diagnostic does not provide an independent clean-install closure for the patch control.
The incumbent probe aborts before complete adapter identity, so no performance comparison is admissible.
Three clean processes are diagnostic and below the promotion reliability floor.
The result identifies a current DoeRuntime wedge but does not accept the runtime ownership-cost ledger or create a release blocker.

performance.reason: The incumbent does not complete equivalent work and the workload has no selected execution operation.

receiptOverhead.reason: Matched traced and untraced receipt-overhead samples were not collected.

I0.summary: Ordinary workspace resolution selects webgpu@0.3.0 and aborts before the complete corpus.

I1.summary: Explicitly pinned webgpu@0.3.0 reproduces the native worker crash.

W0.summary: DoeProof reproduces and explains the pinned failure but cannot correct it above the incumbent runtime boundary.

D0.summary: DoeRuntime passes the full compilation corpus, physical provider check, and receipt replay.

P0.summary: The frozen webgpu@0.3.10 patch-level update fails repeated clean-process reliability and does not reproduce its initial failed evidence on replay.

materialOutcome.summary: D0 uniquely completes the frozen corpus with native diagnostics and stable replay while W0 and P0 fail.

costAcceptance.summary: The compilation-only scope and externally sourced P0 package do not yet justify DoeRuntime's complete compatibility, security, packaging, and support obligations.

installation.summary: The diagnostic reused prepared workspaces and the P0 module lacks independent package closure.

supportHardware.summary: Doe and P0 probe the physical AMD Vulkan host, but ambient and pinned incumbents abort before complete adapter identity.

concurrency.summary: The matrix uses sequential clean processes.

teardown.summary: Successful Doe processes clean up, but promotion-scale teardown cycles were not run.

stress.summary: No promotion-scale stress contract was run.

memory.summary: Peak memory was recorded without bounded-growth testing.

receipts.summary: The raw matrix, provider summary, and W0, D0, and P0 replay inputs are hash-bound.

replay.summary: W0 and D0 reproduce their evidence, but P0 changes from failure to pass on replay.

performance.summary: No successful equivalent incumbent work exists for timing.

ownership.summary: Doe demonstrates a current correction wedge, but ownership-cost acceptance and a clean P0 package remain unresolved.

release.summary: wgsl-fns remains diagnostic and does not block Doe releases.
